strings.OFF by default (safety - wipes network c:
OFF by default (safety - wipes network calibration). After the flash,
zero-fills every NVRAM/NVDATA partition from the device's own PIT using
the native Odin flash path. Standard fix for IMEI/network issues and a
common FRP-adjacent step. Works on Odin-protocol (Exynos/Qualcomm)
download mode; MTK download-agent devices use the MediaTek workbench.
strings.OFF by default (safety). Lets odin4 rebo:
OFF by default (safety). Lets odin4 reboot the phone as soon as the flash
finishes. Leave OFF so you can verify the flash completed before rebooting -
a failed write otherwise hides behind a phone that no longer answers.
strings.OFF by default (safety). Lets odin4 skip:
OFF by default (safety). Lets odin4 skip archive entries that have no match
in the device's PIT. Needed for unofficial/custom firmware or region variants
whose partition table differs from the device ('check failure pit' / PIT mismatch).
Only enable for firmware you are certain is correct for this device.
strings.OFF by default (safety). Lets the native:
OFF by default (safety). Lets the native multi-partition flash write a
bootloader whose revision is LOWER than the device's current one.
Flashing a lower BL revision on a newer device can hard-brick it - only
enable when you are certain the older firmware is correct for this device.
strings.OFF by default (safety). The flash refus:
OFF by default (safety). The flash refuses to run without a recent
EFS backup (<30 days) or an authorized-ADB auto-backup. Tick this
ONLY if you already have backups elsewhere - EFS holds IMEI/radio
calibration; losing it without a backup is unrecoverable.
